title: CONNECT-UDP Socket Lifecycle Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9298 socket lifecycle and forwarding policy.
scope: This verification covers non-connected socket source address and port matching, unmatched packet discard, socket/request stream lifetime coupling, socket-unusable close behavior, inactivity timeout policy, minimum two-minute inactivity guidance, no-fragmentation forwarding, silent oversized datagram drops, and IPv4 DF intent when supported.
preconditions: RFC 9298 tunnel setup and datagram format policy helpers are trace-owned.
expected_result: The focused socket lifecycle policy tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9298 lifecycle artifacts, generated triage reflects the slice as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9298 socket lifecycle and forwarding policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. Live adapter integration and ProtocolLab performance proof remain future work.
